# Perplexity API Changelog — captured 2026-07-03

## May 2026 [top dated entry; cached — still newest]
- Finance Search tool for Agent API: structured financial data (quotes, financials, earnings, analyst estimates, ETFs, OHLCV, pre/after-hours); model autonomously selects fields.

## April 2026 [cached]
- Agent API + third-party models: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Grok 4.20 Reasoning.
- API key one-time-reveal security model.
- n8n + OpenClaw integrations; AWS Marketplace; GET /v1/models endpoint.

## March 2026 [cached]
- Models: GPT-5.4, NVIDIA Nemotron, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro. Gemini 2.5 removed. /v1/agent canonical.

## Feb 2026: Agent API + Embeddings API GA. Dec 2025: Media Classifier; Search API max_tokens/last_updated_filter/Vercel SDK. Nov 2025: Pro Search GA; MCP Server one-click install (Cursor/VS Code/Claude Desktop). (earlier history cached.)

API reference (/v1/agent) tools now surfaced: web search (domain/date/geo filters), Finance search, People search, URL fetch (≤10), Sandbox execution (isolated code), custom function tools (JSON schema), and **`mcp` tool — connect remote MCP servers for extended capabilities** [NEW in reference vs prior scan; NOT confirmed by any dated changelog entry]. Presets: fast-search, pro-search, deep-research. Reasoning effort low/med/high + now **xhigh/max** [new levels in reference]. research loop max_steps 1-10; SSE streaming.
